sources.message: Fetched the actual October2026 thread via Algolia API:266 top-level posts,25 mentioning designer/UX/design-engineer terms. No verified India-eligible UX/product internship or junior role from this pass. Cardog and Sundream retained as conditional company targets.
Selected public company profiles/jobs support SuperKalam, Coulomb AI and Cardboard discovery.

Expanded targeted searches beyond four earlier listings. Four new relevant details retained with undisclosed stipend (Icogz, VictorFlow, Balusen, Gunadhya), plus genuine cross-post enrichments. Numerous other interns are below pay floor, unpaid, wrong discipline or expired; no inference that search counts equal relevant vacancies.

Direct/domain public queries again reported robots restrictions. No newly verified original Naukri role; existing employer-linked route retained. Account connection was not tested or required for these public-source checks; do not imply signed-in access.

Qoruz junior product UX alternative found with annual pay preserved; Ungrammary matching internship adds below-target advertised pay context. Monsoonfish/Integra/AMPM below target and unrelated Product Management roles excluded. Current public examples were mostly below target: Integra Magna INR 3–5k/month, AMPM INR 10–15k/month, SDS INR 7–15k/month. BigThinkCode has an annual INR 1–3 lakh header and restrictive cohort/certification requirements, retained as company research. Ungrammary cross-post adds an annual range and inactive-recruiter caveat to an existing role.

Targeted design searches found BigThinkCode deadline14 Oct 2026 and Virtual Tech2024closed; neither added as active. Competition/hackathon results are not jobs. Targeted search returned competitions with INR 30k prize pools rather than monthly internship pay. No competition prize was treated as an employer stipend.
Public domain search reported robots restriction. No new original role verified; no CAPTCHA bypass or signed-in session attempted.

Targeted indexed design-intern/0–1 year queries produced no independently verified eligible detail in this pass. This is a coverage limitation, not proof of no jobs; authenticated matching workflow not inspected.

Several indexed internships were expired on direct check; accessible ads often unpaid or below target. Attira preserved as company/conditional research, no proven qualifying stipend. Accounts may be needed to apply/save, not to research these public detail pages.

Documented public API checks: India product-designer internships returned 0; UX internships returned 6, including five developer/graphic roles and GWEN fee-based training. Category counts alone do not establish suitable vacancies.

No suitable India-eligible UX/product internship or fresher role verified in the examined public sample. Visible roles were predominantly senior/principal/manager or geographically restricted. Category-level Anywhere in the World labels are insufficient evidence of country eligibility.
